title: Card due dates and overdue filtering

criteria.M1: Date can be set, changed, cleared, and persists; existing cards remain undated.
criteria.M2: Past dates accepted and malformed dates rejected atomically.
criteria.M3: Date appears on detail and board preview; absent dates have no badge.
criteria.M4: Overdue honors viewer timezone and strict earlier-than-today comparison.
criteria.M5: Closing suppresses overdue; reopening restores it; clearing removes it.
criteria.M6: Overdue combines with board, assignee, tag filters across pagination/refresh.
criteria.M7: Direct requests and filter results preserve account and board authorization.
criteria.M8: Existing filters and card workflows retain their behavior.
